basic_info.description: This well maintained 2-level condo offers a rare opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors. 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, PLUS a studio on the ground floor, a formal living, dining room, kitchen, fireplace, and in-unit laundry. This home showcases hardwood floors throughout, updated kitchens and bathrooms, and double-pane windows for modern comfort. No HOA, self-managed. Spacious garage with generous storage and additional laundry area. Unit #2 is also for sale, perfect for multi-generational living, a live-rent arrangement, or a full investment strategy. Located just steps from Golden Gate Park, UCSF, public transit (N-Muni, L-Muni, 7, 48, 28 and more!), restaurants, shops, and parks, this home blends the best of city living with a peaceful neighborhood vibe.
